newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Heavy wins $282 mln ship orders.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Heavy wins $282 mln ship orders.

text.p: Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd, the machinery and shipbuilding affiliate of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Wednesday it had won $282 million worth of orders to build six ships for European companies.

Chandris Inc of Greece placed orders to build two 105,000 deadweight tonne (dwt) crude carriers while Kristen Navigation Inc of Greece will build another two crude carriers. The deal carried an option giving Daewoo priority to win another $100 million in shipbuilding orders from the Greek shipowners.
Daewoo Heavy also won two bulk carrier orders from Louis Dreyfus Armateurs S.N.C. of France.
The six ships are due to be delivered to the shipowners by August, 1999.
